title: Words That Belong Together
text:
Fluent academic writers rarely choose words one by one. Instead, they draw on ready-made combinations such as make a decision, pose a question, or strike a balance. These combinations, known as collocations, signal to the reader that the writer belongs to the discipline. A sentence that says take a decision instead of make a decision may be understood, yet it immediately sounds foreign to an experienced reader.

Learners can build a reliable sense of collocation by noticing which words regularly appear together in journals and textbooks. A useful habit is to record each new phrase with a sample sentence and to check its frequency in a corpus. Over time, the phrases begin to feel natural, and the writer no longer needs to translate from their first language. Accuracy of this kind is a sign of growing academic confidence rather than simply a larger vocabulary.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do fluent academic writers draw on?
options: Single words chosen one by one

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what is a useful habit for learners?
options: Recording each new phrase with a sample sentence
Translating every phrase word by word

questions.text: What can be inferred about the sentence that says take a decision?
options: It may be understood but sounds unusual to experienced readers
It is the standard academic form
It shows the writer is a native speaker

questions.text: What does the writer suggest about accuracy with collocations?
options: It shows growing academic confidence rather than just a larger vocabulary
It depends only on natural talent
It is unimportant for academic writing
It can be achieved by translating from the first language

vocabulary.definition: able to write or speak easily and accurately
fixed combinations of words that commonly occur together
able to be trusted to give consistent results
how often something happens or appears

paragraph_translations: አቀላጥፈው የሚጽፉ የአካዳሚክ ጸሐፊዎች ቃላትን አንድ በአንድ አይመርጡም። ይልቁንም እንደ make a decision, pose a question ወይም strike a balance ያሉ ዝግጁ ጥምረቶችን ይጠቀማሉ። collocations ተብለው የሚጠሩት እነዚህ ጥምረቶች ጸሐፊው የዘርፉ አካል መሆኑን ለአንባቢ ያሳያሉ። take a decision የሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ሊገባ ይችላል፤ ነገር ግን ልምድ ላለው አንባቢ ወዲያውኑ እንግዳ ይመስላል።

ተማሪዎች ቃላት በጆርናሎችና በመማሪያ መጻሕፍት ውስጥ ዘወትር አብረው የሚመጡበትን በመለየት አስተማማኝ የ collocation ስሜት መገንባት ይችላሉ። ጠቃሚ ልማድ እያንዳንዱን አዲስ ሐረግ በምሳሌ ዓረፍተ ነገር መመዝገብና ድግግሞሹን በ corpus ውስጥ መፈተሽ ነው። በጊዜ ሂደት ሐረጎቹ ተፈጥሯዊ እየመሰሉ ይመጣሉ፤ ጸሐፊውም ከአፍ መፍቻ ቋንቋው መተርጎም አያስፈልገውም። እንዲህ ያለው ትክክለኛነት ከቃላት ብዛት ይልቅ የአካዳሚክ በራስ መተማመን እያደገ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
